audit: T020 genuinely non-Abelian SU(3) link-field audit
execution_note: The original full-matrix link/Wilson audit passed GitHub Actions run #7. The additional plaquette-curvature audit passed GitHub Actions run #9 on PR #73.

construction.links: Full 3x3 SU(3) matrices exp(i h f_i lambda_a), with distinct noncommuting Gell-Mann generators in the six directions.
construction.gauge_transform: Site-dependent product of rotations generated by lambda_2, lambda_5, lambda_7.
construction.covariant_shift: S_i psi(x) = U_i(x) psi(x+e_i), with U_i^g(x)=g(x)U_i(x)g(x+e_i)^dagger.
construction.nonabelianity: Actual link commutator U_1(0)U_2(0)-U_2(0)U_1(0) is measured, not inferred only from the generator basis.

interpretation: The finite-dimensional gauge-covariance, SU(3) unitarity/determinant, Clifford, and Wilson-form identities pass at roundoff scale. Consistency error decreases for n=2 to n=3; the two-level trend does not establish an asymptotic order, prove hypothesis (C), or prove strong-resolvent/interacting continuum convergence.
